query:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(e.category), ''), 'Lainnya') AS "category!",
               SUM(e.amount) AS "amount!"
        FROM expenses e
        WHERE $1::text IS NULL
           OR e.expense_date >= date_trunc($1, now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY 2 DESC
